stem.en: The green parts around a rose bud are removed while the bud is still small. Which flower part is this, and what was its job?

text.en: Petals, which draw insects to the young bud

feedback.en: Petals are the coloured ring, and they lie inside the green covering.

text.en: Stamens, which give food to the young bud

feedback.en: Stamens make pollen. They sit inside the petals, not around the bud.

text.en: Sepals, which protect the young bud

feedback.en: Yes. Sepals form the outermost ring and protect the flower in the bud stage.

text.en: Pistil, which keeps the young bud closed

feedback.en: The pistil is at the very centre of the flower. It holds the ovules.

explanation.en: The green covering of a bud is made of sepals, the outermost ring of a flower. They protect the other parts in the bud stage. Petals, stamens and the pistil all lie inside them.

hints.en: Which ring of the flower is on the outside of a bud?
The coloured petals, the stamens and the pistil are all inside that ring.
